'''Build notes.''' == Infobox image (October 2026) ==

Build notes (2026-10-21): the infobox now uses [[:File:Set-VB8.1-announcement-banner.jpg]]. It is the Scoundrels 8.1 banner from the 2012 starwarsccg.org home-page slideshow. Wayback shows it there on 20 April, 10 May and 27 May 2012, linked to the 14 April 2012 announcement post. The green [[:File:Set-VB8-logo.jpg]] is the cover banner of the 8.1 release PDF. It matches the 8.2 and 8.3 cover images, so it stays on [[Scoundrels (Virtual Block 8)]] and the Main Page tile.

Where else I looked, with no other Block 8 art found:
* VirtualBlock8_1.pdf: page 1 holds only the green cover banner; pages 2–8 are card slips.
* res.starwarsccg.org (Wayback index): only cardlists/images/v8-title.jpg, plain black text "VIRTUAL BLOCK VIII" (same as the unused [[:File:Set-VB8-title.jpg]]).
* starwarsccg.org 2012–2013 captures: banners scoundrel3.jpg (8.1), agents_3.jpg and agents_82.jpg (8.2); the 8.1 downloads page and the 17 April 2012 Gemme's Blog post on 8.1 have no art.
* Forum: "Scoundrels 8.1" (t=46511) has no images and points to t=46446, which no longer exists.
* Holotable data (Images-HT/legacy): title images for Virtual Blocks 1–6 only. GEMP: no legacy set icons.
* Bill's Google Drive: nothing for Scoundrels or Virtual Block 8. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 11:30, 21 October 2026 (UTC)
